questions.topic: A table scan in a plan and three ways to end it
questions.stem: How can a table scan in a query plan be eliminated?

answer.exemplar: Add a selective index, rewrite the predicate to be sargable, or reduce the scanned range by filtering on an indexed column first.

questions.explanation: Indexes, sargable predicates, and selective filters reduce scanned rows. Cache or hardware changes only mask it.
